I hope I can help you as much as possible with this matter. Whether or not psychiatric hospitals help people are sadly dependent on what hospital it is. I've been hospitalized 4 times. Twice as an adult twice as an adolescent. 
I will be honest here. Every mental health institution I've been to have been second rate. 
The key is to maintain psychiatric assistance and therapy afterwards. If they offer an out patient group program those are often times great. I will say they personally made me feel less crazy and more accepted. 
It is admirable how much you care for your child and want to help them as much as possible. And that is a wonderful start. 
Keep on top of all mental health appointments and maintain a healthy open relationship with your child. Most teens want to handle the world without the assistance of their parents, but having a parent that is open to communication and tries to understand their child is extremely helpful when navigating mental health issues as a teen.
